critical_code_review_comments: Rate limiter is in-memory only (defaultdict) — will not survive server restarts and is per-process (not safe behind multiple workers). Acceptable for MVP but note the limitation. Consider Redis-backed limit before scaling.

Rate limiter also does not consider X-Forwarded-For — behind ingress, request.client.host may resolve to the ingress IP, causing shared throttling across users. Consider trusting X-Forwarded-For's first IP.
get_current_admin dereferences user['email'] without existence guard; safe today (all seeded users have email) but consider .get() for defensive coding.

Public GET /api/enquiries endpoint referenced in old backend_test.py no longer exists (only /api/admin/enquiries requires auth). Old test file has one obsolete test (test_list_enquiries_returns_recent_first) that will now fail — recommend main agent update or remove it.
AuthProvider does /auth/me on every mount; consider caching or using SWR pattern to avoid extra request bursts.
